config.outputs: Require exact generated token IDs/raw answers for all matched control, stage, and trace examples
config.performance_boundary: Step 6 remains canonical. Same-run uninstrumented control repeats 10 warmups and 50 measurements per seed. Profile/trace timings are diagnostics, not speedup measurements.
config.stage_method: Synchronized diagnostic wall times; prefill is first forward minus nested get_image_features; decode is later cached forwards; residual is explicit
config.trace_method: PyTorch CPU+CUDA profiler; one profiler warmup and two active batches per seed; record_shapes/profile_memory true, with_stack false; traces keep native asynchronous stage execution, with only the original whole-batch synchronization
config.utilization_boundary: nvidia-smi samples cover warmups/measurements/file writes; trace GPU activity is union of kernel/copy intervals within annotated batches, not SM occupancy
